about: 전표 수정 창 [H] (거래이력조회(재고) 마무리12) — 작업지시서를 API 로 만들고 수정 창(?no=)의 [H] 에 '신규' 줄이 뜨는지, 출하지시서 수정 창의 [H] 도 본다. 만든 전표는 지운다.

shots.name: 작업지시서 · 출하지시서 [H]
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const it=(await window.__api('GET','/items')).body.find((i)=>i.category==='FINISHED_GOOD'||true);const wh=(await window.__api('GET','/warehouses')).body[0];const d=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);const r=await window.__api('POST','/work-orders/slips',{orderDate:d,lines:[{productId:it.id,plannedQty:1,warehouseId:wh.id}]});sessionStorage.setItem('woH',r.body[0].orderNo);return r.status})()

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true
